newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp sets A$250 mln MTN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp sets A$250 mln MTN.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Southcorp Holdings Ltd has established a A$250 million domestic medium term note programme, with a first tranche issue of A$100 million for 10 years, company treasurer Brian Chapman said.
Chapman told Reuters it was the first issue by a true corporate in Australia of a 10 year bond facility.
The floating rate note issue was priced at 50 basis points over the 90-day bank bill swap rate and would mature on December 15, 2006, he said.
"The purpose really is to finetune our debt structure so we have a longer maturity profile," he said, adding there were no plans currently for further issues under the programme.
Chapman said the first tranche was issued on December 20.
"We have had tremendous demand for the paper under this issue which is really good because it is a first and almost a benchmark issue for Australia," he said.
The National Australia Bank arranged the programme, and Bankers Trust Australia, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, and Westpac Banking Corp were additional dealers, he said.
